#!/bin/bash
# Idempotent setup: SSH git server + nginx HTTPS deploy targets.
set -x

### 1. git user with password auth
id -u git >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash git
echo 'git:password' | chpasswd
# make sure account is not locked/expired
passwd -u git 2>/dev/null || true
chage -E -1 -M 99999 git 2>/dev/null || true

### 2. bare repo at /git/project
mkdir -p /git
if [ ! -d /git/project/refs ]; then
  git init --bare /git/project
fi
git config --system --add safe.directory /git/project
git config --system --add safe.directory '*'

### 3. deploy targets
mkdir -p /var/www/main /var/www/dev
chown -R git:git /var/www/main /var/www/dev

### 4. post-receive hook
cat > /git/project/hooks/post-receive <<'HOOK'
#!/bin/bash
# Deploy pushed branches to their web roots.
export GIT_DIR=/git/project
unset GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH

deploy() {
  local branch="$1" dest="$2"
  git --git-dir=/git/project rev-parse --verify -q "refs/heads/$branch" >/dev/null || return 0
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  # clean checkout of the branch tree into dest
  local idx
  idx=$(mktemp /tmp/deploy-index-XXXXXX)
  rm -f "$idx"
  GIT_DIR=/git/project GIT_WORK_TREE="$dest" GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" \
    git checkout -f "$branch" -- . 2>/dev/null
  GIT_DIR=/git/project GIT_WORK_TREE="$dest" GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" \
    git read-tree "$branch" 2>/dev/null
  GIT_DIR=/git/project GIT_WORK_TREE="$dest" GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" \
    git checkout-index -a -f --prefix="$dest/" 2>/dev/null
  rm -f "$idx"
  chmod -R a+rX "$dest" 2>/dev/null
}

while read -r oldrev newrev refname; do
  case "$refname" in
    refs/heads/main)   deploy main /var/www/main ;;
    refs/heads/master) deploy master /var/www/main ;;
    refs/heads/dev)    deploy dev  /var/www/dev ;;
  esac
done

# safety net: (re)deploy both known branches regardless of what was parsed
deploy main /var/www/main
deploy dev  /var/www/dev
exit 0
HOOK
chmod 755 /git/project/hooks/post-receive

### 5. permissions so git user can push
chown -R git:git /git
chmod -R g+rwX /git/project

### 6. self-signed cert
mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl
if [ ! -f /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 3650 \
    -keyout /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key -out /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt \
    -subj "/CN=localhost" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1"
  chmod 600 /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key
fi

### 7. nginx site
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/deploy <<'CONF'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl;
    server_name localhost;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key;

    root /var/www/main;
    index index.html;
    autoindex on;

    location /dev/ {
        alias /var/www/dev/;
        index index.html;
        try_files $uri $uri/index.html =404;
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}
CONF
ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/deploy /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/deploy

### 8. sshd config
mkdir -p /run/sshd /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-git.conf <<'SSHD'
Port 22
PasswordAuthentication yes
PermitRootLogin yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
KbdInteractiveAuthentication yes
ChallengeResponseAuthentication yes
UsePAM yes
PermitUserEnvironment no
SSHD
ssh-keygen -A

### 9. relaxed client-side host key checking (container-local convenience)
cat > /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/00-local.conf <<'SC'
Host *
    StrictHostKeyChecking no
    UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null
    LogLevel ERROR
SC
grep -q 'ssh_config.d' /etc/ssh/ssh_config || echo 'Include /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/*.conf' >> /etc/ssh/ssh_config

### 10. start services
pkill -x sshd 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3
/usr/sbin/sshd
nginx -t && (nginx -s reload 2>/dev/null || nginx)

sleep 1
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':22|:8443'
